promptZh: 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，根据每个空格给出的中文提示，在空格处填入恰当的单词或短语（同义表达均可）。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文讲述李明珍惜爷爷赠送的旧自行车，并在朋友车辆损坏时慷慨相助的故事。
explanation.ruleZh: 完形填空需结合上下文逻辑、固定搭配和语法结构综合判断，注意时态与语篇情感一致。

segments.text: When Li Ming turned twelve, his grandfather gave him an old bicycle. The paint had faded, and one of the bells
not work, but Li Ming loved it

Every morning, he rode three kilometres to school with his best friend Yang Fan, who
beside him on a shiny blue bike. On rainy days, the road
muddy, and Li Ming often fell.

, he never thought of leaving the old bicycle at home.

One afternoon, Yang Fan's blue bike broke down on the way home. Without

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 助动词过去式，与 not 连用（铃不响）
gaps.explanationZh: 主语 one of the bells 为单数且动作发生在过去，否定助动词用 did not。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.explanationZh: 与 any new bike in the shop 比较，loved it more than 表示更爱旧车。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: who 引导定语从句修饰 Yang Fan，叙述过去每天同行，用 rode。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.explanationZh: 雨天路面变得泥泞，became/got/was/turned 均可接形容词 muddy。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句说常摔倒，后句说从不想把车留在家，语义转折用 However。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.explanationZh: without 是介词后接动名词，think twice 表示犹豫。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.explanationZh: let his friend sit/ride on the back seat，let 后接不带 to 的不定式。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.clue: twice as ... as 结构（时间长）
gaps.explanationZh: twice as long as usual 表示花费的时间是平时的两倍。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.clue: 引导宾语从句的连接副词（为什么）
gaps.explanationZh: 爷爷询问他晚归的原因，asked why he was so late。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.explanationZh: 后句说自行车也承载友谊，说明它不只是一个工具。
